name: How do I know if my pool needs resurfacing?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my pool needs resurfacing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common indicators that your pool needs resurfacing include a rough or abrasive surface that snags swimsuits or scrapes skin, persistent staining that cannot be cleaned, visible cracks or delamination of the existing finish, or a general dulling and fading of the pool's interior. You might also notice an increase in algae growth due to a compromised surface. Addressing these signs promptly can prevent more extensive and costly repairs down the line.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for rough surfaces, persistent stains, cracks, fading, or increased algae. These indicate it's time for resurfacing.
